ma.onError(function callback)

Listen for Mini Program error events.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function for reporting Mini Program error events.

Parameter

string error

Error information, including stack information.

Sample Code

let _this;
let test1 = function () {
    console.log('aaa')
    _this.setData({
        detail: _this.data.detail + '\r\n' + 'onError:ok',
    })
};

Page({
    onError () {
        _this.setData({
            detail: _this.data.detail + '\r\n' + 'onError',
        })
        ma.onError(test1)
    }
})
